objective: Reconstruct the Phase 12 odd-orbit packing boundary, finite audit, all-contact exclusion, and mod-6-only obstruction without promoting them to a Collatz proof.

quantifiers: all S congruent to 3 modulo 4 with 3 <= S <= 100000 for E20
the first 512 odd positions of the all-contact mechanical word
the first 4096 terms of the exact abstract coprime-to-6 saturator
exact_scope.completeness: Exhaustive only over the stated finite domains; P72 and P73 use the separate symbolic argument recorded in PHASE12_RUN_RESULTS.md.

arithmetic.floating_point_role: No floating-point value is accepted as a proof decision.

stop_conditions: Stop and record the least exact obstruction if a symbolic identity, digest, or adversarial reconstruction fails.
Do not enlarge the finite range to compensate for a failed universal statement.
Enter the proof-claim emergency protocol before changing proves_collatz.
interpretation_boundary: P72 does not exclude every infinite coefficient-safe tail.
P73 excludes only the all-contact mechanical word.
E20 is a bounded audit and is not asymptotic evidence.
NG21 is an abstract non-orbit obstruction and does not prove dynamic optimality of exponent 1/9.
The nontrivial-cycle and finite-crossing renewal-ladder branches remain open.
